title: fix(platform-objects, plugin-security, plugin-approvals, service-messaging, objectql): Setup field help is written for administrators, and the inert access-review fields are hidden
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao79xdvASVbExtbmLctNuuEG)_

Fixes #25331

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling carried: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, record `6354968262`:

> 25251 B hotcrm B

It adopts T2-U02. The card's *Done when* is the acceptance.

## What changes

Each developer string the Setup pass met is replaced by help an administrator can act on: what the field means and what to do with it. Where the old text held a fact a developer needs, that fact moved into the code comment beside the field.

| Field | Was | Now says |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `sys_user_permission_set.user_id`, `sys_user_position.user_id` | "Foreign key to sys_user." | the user who receives the set / holds the position |
| `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` | "… NULL only on a grant written before the column existed." | pick a permission set defined in Setup; an unknown name is rejected |
| `last_certified_at`, `certified_by` (both objects) | "Reserved for a future access-recertification workflow … Inert today: no platform code writes this column …" | not in use yet, kept for a future access-review feature; **and `hidden: true`** |
| `sys_approval_delegation.valid_from` | "Enforced at resolution time via isGrantActive …" | checked each time an approval is routed, no scheduled job |
| `sys_notification_preference.digest` | "Batch cadence (P3 digest middleware)." | what none / daily / weekly do, critical notifications are never batched, set it on a `*` channel row |
| `sys_notification_preference.quiet_hours` | "Optional { tz, start, end } window (P3 quiet-hours middleware)." | an example value, HH:MM in the time zone, may wrap midnight, critical not held, `*` channel row |
| `sys_user.ai_access`, `sys_user.locale` | "… plugin-hono-server resolveCtx … AiSeatPlugin … Owned by objectql (better-auth is oblivious to this column)." | what the seat gives and that the license caps it; the language tag and its fallback |
| `sys_oauth_access_token` / `_refresh_token` / `_consent` / `_client_resource` reference fields | "Foreign key to sys_user.id" (and to `sys_oauth_application.client_id`, `sys_session.id`, `sys_oauth_refresh_token.id`, `sys_oauth_resource.identifier`) | which user, application, session, refresh token or resource it is |
| `sys_metadata.package_version_id` | "Foreign key to sys_package_version (UUID). …" | the package release the metadata came from, empty for built-in and local changes |
| Data Lifecycle settings page and its Retention overrides help | "Governance for ADR-0057 … LifecycleService (Reaper / Rotator / Archiver)", "(ADR-0057 §3.2)" | what the page controls and that the periodic cleanup sweep applies it |

The behaviour claims in the new digest and quiet-hours help were read from `service-messaging/src/preference-resolver.ts` (`resolveDigest` / `resolveQuietHours` read only the channel `*` row; `critical` bypasses both; `digestDeferral` flushes at local midnight and Monday 00:00).

**Hidden, not deleted.** `last_certified_at` and `certified_by` on `sys_user_permission_set` and `sys_user_position` now carry `hidden: true`, the field's own "Hidden from default UI" flag. objectui's form auto-layout (`plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`) and the record detail panel (`plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailPanel.tsx`) both skip a `hidden` field. The columns, their stored values and the API are unchanged. No other field's help says it is inert.

**Bundles.** `en` regenerated from the sources (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`). The `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` values of every rewritten leaf were translated by hand (they were translations of the old developer text, or for the `ja-JP` / `es-ES` approvals and messaging leaves, byte copies of it). The generator then dropped the four `source-hashes.generated.ts` entries that recorded those byte copies, which is its documented behaviour once a leaf is translated. The AI Access help keeps the word "capability" (`ai_seat` capability, 能力 / ケイパビリティ): two translation-decision tests derive the capability wording from that leaf.

**Pin.** The four existing admin-copy vocabulary tests (`platform-objects` `setup-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`, `plugin-security`, `plugin-approvals`, `service-messaging` `admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`) gain five entries: a foreign-key note, the `isGrantActive` function name, an internal component (`middleware`, "better-auth is oblivious", `Reaper`), the "NULL only on" storage note and the "Inert today" notice, each with a positive control. They walk every object this package ships and every leaf of all four locale bundles. `plugin-security`'s test also asserts the four access-review fields are `hidden`. The settings manifest had no copy test, so `objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-settings.test.ts` is new (ADR number, section reference, internal component names).

## Surface note: one string outside the declared surface

`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts` (`package_version_id` help) is outside the claim's file surface. It is the same defect class, a one-line mechanical rewrite, and it is in the population `platform-objects`' vocabulary test already walks (that test reads metadata-core's objects, and the help lands in the `platform-objects` bundle), so the new "foreign key" entry could not go green without it. Taken under os-dev's bounded in-place fix; the seat amends the file surface.

## Verification (head `ee5da23123`)

- `pnpm turbo run test --only --continue` on the six packages: metadata-core 19/19 files, platform-objects 88/88, plugin-security 212/212, plugin-approvals 94/94, service-messaging 60/60, objectql 465/465 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). A first run went red in two `platform-objects` translation-decision tests that read `sys_user.fields.ai_access.help` as evidence for the capability wording; fixed by keeping the capability in that help.
- `pnpm turbo run typecheck --only` on the six packages: 6/6 (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: all ten packages in sync.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 71 families, 70 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: this worktree has no full workspace build). `--ran` reconciles 71/71. CI runs the rest of the farm.
- No ablation: the change is copy and a declared flag; each new vocabulary entry carries a positive-control assertion that it matches the old string.

## Acceptance notes

- `better-auth` still appears in 34 `platform-objects` `en` field-help leaves (for example "Managed by better-auth"), and a few helps name code identifiers (`resolveCtx`-style names, `sys_business_unit_member.is_primary`, `sys_file.name`). They are outside this card's list and on surfaces the pass did not report; noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- `[ADR-0086 D3]` from the card has 0 hits in any object or metadata-forms bundle on `origin/main`. It survives in `packages/spec` schema `.describe()` text (`security/capabilities.ts` `packageId`, `permission.zod.ts` `packageId`). Whether the Capabilities detail page the tester saw renders that `.describe()` text is NOT MEASURED here (no running console); if it does, the fix is in `packages/spec`, outside this card's surface.
- `sys_approval_delegation.organization_id` help is untouched (#25280 owns it).
- #25332 regenerates the same `platform-objects` bundles; whichever lands second merges `main` and re-runs the generator.
